independent_grep_verification.script: _run/s9/p4/out/S8H-A-independent-check.py (this packet's own read-only script, written from scratch -- separate mask/scan logic from LINT-9/LINT-5, used as a cross-check not a re-run)

check_1_midline_carat_count.method: Per content/**/*.md: skip frontmatter + fenced code blocks; blank HTML comments; mask [[wikilinks]] / ![[embeds]] / `inline code` to non-word filler; scan remaining text for '^token' matches (a caret-pin anchor NOT literally preceded by a wikilink-opening '['); a match is a LEAK iff it does NOT end at end-of-line (after rstrip).
check_1_midline_carat_count.cross_check_raw_grep: grep -rnoE '^pin-[A-Za-z0-9]+' content --include='*.md' | wc -l = 1403 total ^pin-N tokens anywhere in the corpus (end-of-line legal anchors + inside wikilinks + any leaks); of these, independent masking found 0 that are both outside a wikilink/embed AND not at end-of-line.

check_2_broken_pin_wikilinks.method: Every [[Target#^pin-N]] / ![[Target#^pin-N]] (pipe-display stripped per the R11 `\|` convention) resolved to a content/**/*.md page by relative-stem / basename match; target page's body then scanned for a line ending in that exact ^pin-N token (the Obsidian block-anchor DEFINITION rule) -- resolves iff both the page AND the anchor exist.
check_2_broken_pin_wikilinks.cross_check_raw_grep: grep -rno '#^pin-[A-Za-z0-9]*' content --include='*.md' | wc -l = 287, exactly matching the script's pin_wikilink_total (287) -- confirms the parser is not over/under-counting refs before resolving them.
